summary: Purple Biotech Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 23, 2026, solely to attach an updated corporate presentation for June 2026. The filing contains no transaction announcement, no specific deal terms, no board recommendation, and no event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a routine disclosure of an investor presentation by a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event is triggered; the filing is purely informational and forward-looking statements are disclaimed. Therefore, this is a routine current report with no actionable event.
